headline: Marcos Pitombo Returns To TV Globo For Upcoming Evening Telenovela
seoTitle: Marcos Pitombo Returns to TV Globo
metaDescription: Actor Marcos Pitombo is returning to TV Globo for the new telenovela Elas que Lutem, scheduled for release in March 2027 after a long hiatus.
aiSummaryBullets: Actor Marcos Pitombo has signed on to appear in the new TV Globo production titled Elas que Lutem.
This role marks the actor's return to the network's telenovela lineup after an absence that began in 2020.
The upcoming seven o'clock evening soap opera is currently slated for a March 2027 premiere.
aiContextParagraph: TV Globo has announced that actor Marcos Pitombo is returning to the broadcaster's programming after a seven-year period away from their specific novelas. His last project with the network was the 2020 production Salve-se Quem Puder. Pitombo has been confirmed as a cast member for the forthcoming evening serial Elas que Lutem. Production schedules indicate that this new program is set to debut on the network in March 2027. This move represents a significant return for the actor to the network's traditional weekday evening programming block, which typically commands substantial viewership in Brazil. The announcement regarding the casting has prompted increased search interest among fans tracking the actor's career developments and the network's future television schedule.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to significant search interest regarding the actor's return to a major national broadcaster after his extended absence from serial television.
